title: Premier Whale and Dolphin Watching
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Prepare for an unforgettable encounter with the giants of the sea. Our 3.5-hour premium whale watching expedition takes you beyond the shoreline and into the heart of the ocean’s most spectacular playground. Whether you’re a seasoned nature lover or a first-time explorer, this journey offers the perfect balance of excitement and coastal relaxation. This trip is highly recommended during Blue Whale season (June – September). Since these 100-foot giants migrate further offshore, we recommend these trips during blue whale season as the extended time they provide give us a wider window to secure a successful sighting. Witnessing the largest animal to ever live is a true once-in-a-lifetime moment—maximize your
chances by booking during their peak summer residency.
